So, about 4 weeks ago I started exercising daily, as well as eating at least 1 piece of fresh fruit and 1 fresh veggie daily. Life happened, I stopped it all, I found this sub and started up again.

I just wanted to say that for as long as I can remember, my goal was to wake up, exercise, and meditate. I felt that if I did that, I would be more focused during the day and healthier.

Well, today I did it. I just wanted to. And I realized that if I quit hitting snooze I would have the time to do it. I'm not running a marathon each morning, but it's a start. And for me, when I make my goal nonzero days, it creates the habit, and it's much easier to expand an established habit than to just create a big one out of stress.

So, happy November 1st. Happy 21 days of change. It's going to be hard, but you can do it.
